name: fifth-batch
about: Non-European work, about 20 pieces: Indian and Tibetan, Chinese, Japanese and Ethiopian from Cleveland (with a description to quote) and one Iranian (Qajar) from the Met (no description: needs a hook). The Met, Cleveland and Commons have almost no public-domain paintings with museum text for Latin America, the Pacific, the Middle East (beyond Iran) or Indigenous North America; those wait for the Smithsonian key (docs/TODO.md, Needs Sean). Nothing reaches the game until a person approves a draft.
